description: Author the ~40 missing cmd:<ROOT> Markdown help topics for the FFCMD roots, add the ff-desktop enforcement test asserting every FFCMD root has a conforming cmd:<ROOT> topic with a valid one-liner (FFEDIT deferred, extensions never asserted, no registration-time validation), and confirm the command-framework Req 3.8/3.9 description rule is satisfied by the derived one-liner (context-help Req 21/23 content). Depends on FEAT-001 (short_description) and benefits from FEAT-002 (KEYS/CONFIG now resolve cmd:<ROOT>).
steps: Enumerate the AUTHORITY at implementation time -- do NOT trust a prose list. Read crate::shell::alias_reader::builtin_ffcmd_roots() and its inputs: BUILTIN_FFCMD_LADDER_VERB_ROOTS + BUILTIN_WORKSPACE_VERB_ROOTS in crates/ff-desktop/src/command_config/mod.rs, and the recovery menus' option roots in crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/defaults.rs (recovery_pom_menu / recovery_settings_menu). Cross-check which cmd:<ROOT> topics already ship by scanning help/commands/*.help.md (existing: SAVE, CANCEL, END, UNDO, REDO in session.help.md; HELP/KEYS/POM/SETTINGS/FILES in menu-options.help.md; the navigation verbs in navigation.help.md). The MISSING set to author includes: EXIT, SNAPSHOT, CAPTURE START, CAPTURE STOP, CAPTURE REPLAY, RETRIEVE, START, MENU, CLOSE, DOCK, RETURN, DETACH, SPLIT, UNSPLIT, FOCUS, SWAP, WORKSPACE, PFSHOW, COMMAND, SUBMIT, TIME, STATUS, REFRESH, EDIT, VIEW, BROWSE, COMPARE, CREATE, REPLACE, CONFIG, THEME, CATALOGS, COMMANDS, LOG, PLUGINS, MACROS, GSEARCH, SEARCH, KINDS, MENUS, ALIASES, FILE CATALOGS, RESET BARE -- but reconcile this against the live enumeration and the enforcement test (the test, not the list, is the source of truth).

Author the cmd:<ROOT> topics in a few new files under help/commands/ (group e.g. session-lifecycle.help.md = EXIT/START/MENU/CLOSE/RETURN/WORKSPACE/DOCK/DETACH/SPLIT/UNSPLIT/FOCUS/SWAP/PFSHOW/COMMAND; scrm.help.md = SNAPSHOT/CAPTURE START/CAPTURE STOP/CAPTURE REPLAY/RETRIEVE/SUBMIT/TIME/STATUS/REFRESH; workspace-verbs.help.md = CONFIG/THEME/CATALOGS/COMMANDS/LOG/PLUGINS/MACROS/GSEARCH/SEARCH/KINDS/MENUS/ALIASES/EDIT/VIEW/BROWSE/COMPARE/CREATE/REPLACE). Each topic uses the EXACT delimiter format from help/commands/session.help.md: `<!-- TOPIC: cmd:<ROOT> -->` then `<!-- TITLE: <Human Title> -->`, then at minimum a non-empty `## Description` whose first paragraph is a <=200-char plain one-liner (add `## Syntax` and `## See Also` where natural per Req 7.2). Two-word roots key as `cmd:FILE CATALOGS` and `cmd:RESET BARE` (TopicKey preserves the space). Author cmd:CONFIG (new; MAY See-Also feature:configuration). If the existing cmd:KEYS topic lacks a `## Description`, add one so the extractor yields a one-liner. ASCII-ONLY throughout (no em dash / curly quotes / Unicode arrows).

TDD: write the FAILING ff-desktop enforcement test FIRST in a new module crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_help_enforcement.rs: enumerate EnvironmentRegistry::root_commands("FFCMD"); load the shipped help/ tree the same way shell/help.rs does (reuse the help_search_paths()/ContentLoader loader, build a HelpTopicRegistry, locale "en"); for EACH root assert a cmd:<ROOT> topic is present AND registry.short_description(&TopicKey::command(<ROOT_UPPER>)) is Some and non-empty and <= 200 chars. The test is RED until all topics are authored. Annotate `// Validates: context-help Requirement 23.2/23.3`.

Add a comment in the enforcement test stating FFEDIT roots are OUT OF SCOPE now (Req 23.4, on the roadmap) and extension commands are NEVER asserted (Req 23.5) and degrade gracefully; add NO registration-time validation of extension help anywhere.

Confirm no code path treats command-framework Req 3 as requiring a SEPARATE description literal for a home-grown FFCMD root (the derived one-liner satisfies Req 3.8/3.9); if a registration path asserts a description, add/adjust a test comment noting the derived source satisfies it (do NOT add a duplicated literal). The steering file .kiro/steering/command-help-guideline.md already records the extension guideline; verify it exists and needs no change.
Keep every new source file <= 400 non-test lines (split the enforcement test module if it grows).
acceptance_criteria: Every FFCMD root returned by EnvironmentRegistry::root_commands("FFCMD") has a loaded cmd:<ROOT> topic in the shipped help/ tree whose short_description extracts to a non-empty <=200-char one-liner (context-help Req 21/23.2).

The ff-desktop enforcement test enumerates root_commands("FFCMD"), loads the help tree, and FAILS if any enforced root lacks a conforming topic; it EXCLUDES FFEDIT and asserts nothing about extension commands (Req 23.3/23.4/23.5).
All authored help topics use the existing <!-- TOPIC --> / <!-- TITLE --> delimiter format and are ASCII-only; two-word roots key correctly as cmd:FILE CATALOGS / cmd:RESET BARE.
No registration-time validation of extension help is added; command-framework Req 3 is satisfied for FFCMD roots by the derived one-liner.
Running `cargo test -p ff-desktop <enforcement_test_name>` passes (GREEN after topics authored).
verification: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop ffcmd_roots_have_conforming_help"  (or the chosen enforcement test name; read proxy result; expect GREEN)
C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Select-String -Path 'help/commands/*.help.md' -Pattern '[^\x00-\x7F]'"  (expect NO matches -- ASCII-only help prose)
